name: Nezu Jirou / Rat
original_name: 根津 次郎 / ラット
source:
A member of "Thieves' Empire".
A young boy with a Flame Toy used for lighting various explosives. Undercover as a classmate. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Thieves.27_Empire]Wikipedia[/url].]
